_comment: Copy this file to inventory-concepts.config.json (sibling to inventory-concepts.cjs) and fill it in with YOUR guild's own concept-routing data. inventory-concepts.cjs ships with none of this baked in -- every field below is optional and defaults to an empty/generic value if the config file is absent.

semantic_owner_rules._comment: Fictional worked example -- routes any concept slug matching the pattern to an existing owner plan instead of letting the inventory suggest a brand-new /plan-task for it.

closure_review_rules._comment: Fictional worked example -- flags a concept slug as needing a closure/supersession check rather than fresh planning.
closure_review_rules.reason: Likely superseded by patron-alpha-onboarding-v2; inspect the live proposal before creating any new plan.
